title: A Free Music Festival Before the Big Game
summary:
College football's biggest game is getting a musical warm-up that will not cost fans a cent. The free AT&T Playoff Playlist Live festival takes place on January 23-24 in Las Vegas, just before the big game on January 25.

Two top teams will play the big game at Allegiant Stadium. Star DJs will play pump-up music at the festival, at the Grand Prix Plaza, just off the Strip. Doors open at 3 p.m. on both days.

Night one brings David Guetta, Marshmello, Alison Wonderland, Honeyluv, and Girl Math; day two brings John Summit, Fisher, Sofi Tukker, Korolova, and DJ Skilah.

"No city embraces the variety of music genres like Las Vegas," said Ryan Allen Hall of the College Football Playoff.

"The magic for us is to bring together this stacked lineup in Las Vegas and charge the fans absolutely nothing," Hall said.

Last year's festival in Miami Beach, with John Summit, Calvin Harris, Peso Pluma, and Latin Mafia, drew about 50,000 people.
why_it_matters: A free festival means any family can enjoy the music and the excitement of a big game weekend, even without tickets to the game.
